priority_zone_definition: NDBI >= Phase 1 median NDBI threshold AND TVDI >= stress_threshold

assumption_sources.delta_ndvi_greening: Scenario assumption (feasible urban canopy/green-infrastructure expansion); not a measured intervention outcome.
assumption_sources.lst_offset_pavement: Literature-informed (Vizzari, Leiva-Padilla & Hu, 2025, IntechOpen, DOI 10.5772/intechopen.1012755; general cool-pavement field literature reports ~1.5-4 degC surface cooling); not measured in Lagos.

caveat: This is a scenario simulation layered on the study's own fitted TVDI edges, not a physically-resolved microclimate model and not field-validated for Lagos.
